item.title: David Ellefson Talks Megadeth Split: 'I Haven’t Spoken To Dave In Four Years'
item.description: Former Megadeth bassist David Ellefson says the band’s “last album” and 2026 farewell tour announcement hit him as “a little shocking,” even if the news wasn’t completely out of the blue.

item.title: DARON MALAKIAN Says SYSTEM Of A DOWN's Future Is 'Out Of His Control' And Tells Fans To 'Stop Asking For Another Toxicity'
item.description: SYSTEM OF A DOWN guitarist and songwriter Daron Malakian says the future of the band is not up to him, and he wants fans to stop expecting another Toxicity.

item.title: DANI FILTH Announces ASHOK’s Firing From CRADLE OF FILTH ‘Effective Immediately’; Latin American Tour Dates Proceed As Scheduled
item.description: Cradle of Filth cut ties with longtime guitarist Marek “Ashok” Šmerda effective immediately, hours after he told fans he planned to leave at the end of the current Latin American run.

item.title: DAVID ELLEFSON Says DAVE MUSTAINE Wanted to Re-Record METALLICA Demo
item.description: In a recent episode of The David Ellefson Show, former Megadeth bassist David Ellefson shared some revealing details about his final years with the band, focusing on what he described as a toxic environment and an unexpected proposal from Dave Mustaine.

item.title: The Metallica Megahit Classic That 'SUCKS', According To JAMES HETFIELD
item.description: In a not-so-recent behind-the-scenes video, Metallica fans got an unexpected moment: James Hetfield, frontman of one of the most famous metal bands on the planet, didn’t hold back when asked about one of the group’s earliest hits.

item.title: The Controversial Reason METALLICA Members Didn’t Like JASON NEWSTED, According to JAMES HETFIELD
item.description: In a revealing interview from 2018, Metallica frontman James Hetfield opened up about a difficult chapter in the band’s history: their treatment of bassist Jason Newsted, who joined the group following the death of Cliff Burton in 1986.

item.title: Is This How It Ends? AARON STAINTHORPE Unsure If He’s Still the Vocalist of MY DYING BRIDE
item.description: Aaron Stainthorpe isn’t entirely sure whether he’s still the lead singer of My Dying Bride. The British doom metal band recently returned to the stage with Mikko Kotamäki, from Swallow the Sun, handling vocals.

item.title: Spinal Tap Director ROB REINER Calls BLACK SABBATH 'Dumb' Over Stonehenge Accusation: 'It’s Ridiculous'
item.description: The director behind This Is Spinal Tap is calling out Black Sabbath for something that happened over 40 years ago, and he’s not pulling any punches. In a recent interview with Screen Rant, filmmaker Rob Reiner revisited a long-standing misunderstanding between the legendary heavy metal band and the makers of the cult comedy film.

item.title: The Disgusting Reason Metallica's JAMES HETFIELD Hates LOAD and RELOAD Album Covers
item.description: Metallica’s mid-’90s albums, Load and Reload, are remembered for more than just a shift in musical style. Their cover art caused a stir too, especially with frontman James Hetfield.

item.title: VENOM INC.'s TONY DOLAN Reacts To Public Accusations From MANTAS: 'They All Blame Me For Their Own Demise'
item.description: Tony Dolan is setting the record straight. The bassist and vocalist of VENOM INC. recently addressed his fallout with guitarist Jeff “Mantas” Dunn, who officially left the band in late 2023.

item.title: DAVID ELLEFSON Says MEGADETH Took Credit For 'Soldier On!': 'Just Wiped My Name Off'
item.description: David Ellefson isn’t done unpacking his past with Megadeth,and he’s brought receipts. In a new interview with The Delz Show, the former bassist draws some not-so-subtle contrasts between how Metallica handled songwriting credits with Dave Mustaine and how Mustaine allegedly did the opposite when it came to Megadeth’s own track, Soldier On!
